historical_record.description: The corner lot at Laurel Street, 41¼ by 62 feet, stood vacant; with the lot beside it to the east, it had been a gasoline service station.
The lot to the east of the corner, also 41¼ by 62 feet, was vacant but for a small one-storey shed.

The City Planning Commission unanimously refused a three-storey commercial building with no off-street parking on the corner lot, urging its owner and the owner of the lot to the east to build instead a single shop-and-office building with ten parking spaces, as agreed with the neighbours (Resolution 7470).
